caption: The drawing depicts an open envelope-style satchel or handbag. The main body of the bag is a dark, mottled green color with diagonal lines forming a crossed pattern on the front. The flap of the bag is open, showing an interior lining that is a muted reddish-pink with a textured appearance. There are two metal hooks or clasps visible on the inside of the flap, which would presumably be used to secure the bag when closed. The edge of the flap has a brown trim, and there is a small metallic or gray clasp at the center top of the flap for fastening. A long, narrow brown strap is attached to the bag, looping upwards and curving to the right and below the base of the bag. The background is a plain off-white or beige, with no additional objects or details visible.
title: Purse
